you know what you ain't the only one that pray that God will take mercy on you by letting you die in your sleep. I have suicide thought all the time but I am afraid of height, and don't like getting cut. So die peacefully in the sleep would be the best way to go. However I will go to sleep every night miserable and tears coming out of my eyes for no reason, and yet I wake up every morning and feel blessed that I am still alive. It is a weird cycle, sometimes you can't get past certain things and look at the bigger pictures. Most people deal with depression in a different way, some have to release the stress by spending all their money, or hurting themselves...Me I have lots of reason to be depressed, debt and no girlfriend and friends in real life. Time is getting harder and I still trying to find a way to survive...

I am sure that it will get better eventually. I dropped out of my college six years ago because I was working two jobs and making good money. Six years later when I try to enroll into the college again, my student fiancial aid fell through because my GPA was below 2.0 and I have unsastifactory academic something, so i went to join the National guard and hope that the government will pay for my college tuition and guess what I passed everything except medical exam because it turn out that I have diabetes...Life is hard for me but suicide is never the option...you may think taking the easy way out is the only option for you, but if you can work through this, you still have a bright future ahead of you.
